name: AFTERFORM
premise: A garment-repair studio that turns uncertainty about a repair into a clear request, an explicit decision and a useful garment record.
status: Self-directed concept; no actual customers, research participants, repairs or bookings.

concepts.name: AFTERFORM
concepts.idea: A garment-repair studio connecting a considered repair request to labels, return packaging and a garment record.
concepts.why: A person should not need tailoring vocabulary to describe a problem or understand a changed proposal.
concepts.users: People keeping favourite clothes; studio assessors managing uncertain material and finish requirements.
concepts.problem: The desired outcome, realistic finish and approval of a change can become disconnected.
concepts.ux: Assisted intake, uncertainty handling, explicit proposal revisions and a traceable record.
concepts.ui: An editorial workshop desk with readable choices, a comparison of changes and clear completion.
concepts.graphics: Wordmark, repair-code labels, hangtags, care record, receipt, campaign and studio guide.
concepts.identity: Fashion typography meets a repair seam; vermilion, lilac and plum create a new territory.
concepts.physical: A printed guide, garment labels, return sleeve/band, pocket record and studio signs.
concepts.value: Adds label craft, actual packaging panels and customer/studio decision depth.
concepts.different: A service around a physical garment, not an online shop or a generic tracking dashboard.

concepts.name: OFFCUT
concepts.idea: A reclaimed-material library for designers comparing and borrowing architectural samples.
concepts.why: A recovered material needs an understandable specification and sample provenance.
concepts.users: Independent interior designers, makers and material-library staff.
concepts.problem: Appearance alone cannot answer condition, dimensions, availability or return requirements.
concepts.ux: Constraint-based comparison, sample requests, substitution approval and returns.
concepts.ui: Dense but readable specification tables, object records and material categories.
concepts.graphics: Sample labels, specification cards, library catalogue and shelf identifiers.
concepts.identity: Architectural proportions with bold stock markings and tactile photography.
concepts.physical: Sample sleeves, reusable dispatch inserts, shelf labels and fold-out specification sheets.
concepts.different: Focuses on uncertain reclaimed stock rather than standardised retail inventory.

concepts.name: POSTMARK
concepts.idea: A neighbourhood story archive where contributors choose how personal memories are recorded, displayed and accessed.
concepts.why: Preserving a story also means preserving the contributor’s boundaries.
concepts.users: Community contributors, readers, librarians and archive coordinators.
concepts.problem: Contribution, publication permission and future withdrawal are often separate experiences.
concepts.ux: Layered consent, draft review, access levels and withdrawal requests.
concepts.ui: A thoughtful reading and contribution environment with clear privacy choices.
concepts.graphics: Archival tags, oral-history cards, exhibition labels and an annual publication.
concepts.identity: Correspondence and annotated margins, with a distinct stamp-sized visual grammar.
concepts.physical: Collection envelopes, listening cards, exhibition labels and correspondence packs.
concepts.value: Adds sensitive-content architecture and consent reasoning.
concepts.different: Treats access and authorship as a core experience rather than another media feed.

directions.name: Second impression
directions.idea: The garment retains its character; the repair gives it a deliberate new detail.
directions.type: Bodoni Moda display; Karla for reading and UI; Inconsolata for job codes.
directions.photo: Material-led close crops, soft side light, original illustrative repairs.
directions.motifs: A paired stitch, an interrupted rule rejoined by a bridge, and meaningful repair codes.
directions.layout: Large editorial statement beside practical information; asymmetry with restrained margins.
directions.texture: Actual cloth and paper material, never generic overlaid grain.
directions.ui: Quiet reading ground; linear fields; visible labels; decisive plum actions.
directions.motion: Short stitch-like line reveals and clear, reversible state feedback.
directions.print: Vermilion covers, lilac inserts, plum information; one dominant pair per piece.

directions.name: Workshop blue
directions.idea: A practical repair bench becomes a system of instructions and tools.
directions.type: Condensed grotesk display with humanist UI type.
directions.photo: Daylit benches and hands at work, with utilitarian framing.
directions.motifs: Cut lines, measured grids and clear work-stage markers.
directions.layout: Dense modular forms and narrow type bands.
directions.texture: Coated labels, work paper, indigo textiles.
directions.motion: Snapped alignment and short mechanical changes.
directions.reason_not_selected: Blue/coral and operational strips overlap the existing ImHere and Loopline territories.

directions.name: Quiet heirloom
directions.idea: A personal object carries memory across generations.
directions.type: Soft old-style serif with an unobtrusive sans.
directions.motifs: Personal notes, archival tabs and collection folios.
directions.layout: Long reading measures broken by close details.
directions.ui: An archive with calm, readable labels.
directions.print: Small numbered booklets and keepsake cards.
directions.reason_not_selected: Green and warm paper overlap Holland and Loopline; a literary tone overlaps Novella.

research.status: Indexed board discovered; full board inaccessible in the browsing tool. No claim of inspecting its individual artworks.
Research routes supplied; direct Pinterest boards/search pages could not be fully opened.

research.principle: The service explains item/damage information, sending the garment and repair/return; pricing depends on material, location and finish. AFTERFORM uses that context to make uncertainty and approval explicit, without adopting SOJO pricing or promises.
Repair and care are presented as connected aspects of continued garment use.

research.source: New York Custom Labels design guide
research.principle: Label folds and attachment zones affect the available artwork area. AFTERFORM keeps detachable service labels separate from original care labels.
Check actual foreground/background pairs; thin display typography needs additional practical attention.
